panels.title: Sold
panels.description: Confirmed sold policies for the selected time range and filters.

panels.title: Transfers
panels.description: Call transfers that are not sold.

panels.title: Conversion
panels.description: Sold conversion to the total transferred calls

panels.title: 30+ → Sold
panels.description: Share of 30+ minute calls that became sold policies.

panels.title: Below 20 min
panels.description: Share of SALE calls that did not reach the 20+ minute mark.

panels.title: Performance over time
panels.description: Sold, 30+ calls and transfers across the selected time range. Short ranges use hourly buckets; longer ranges use daily buckets.

panels.title: Outcome mix
panels.description: Side-by-side selected-range totals for the three core volume outcomes.

panels.title: Top sellers
panels.description: Top agents ranked by Sold for the selected filters and time range.

panels.title: Agent leaderboard
panels.description: Agent performance. When Client / preset is All, resolved presets are added as dynamic columns showing each agent's transfer count for that preset.

panels.title: Team performance
panels.description: Team performance. When Client / preset is All, resolved presets are added as dynamic columns showing each team's transfer count for that preset.

panels.title: Project performance
panels.description: Compare selected projects. The Project filter above supports selecting several projects at once.

panels.title: Client performance
panels.description: See which client/preset groups are converting and where unresolved preset data exists.

panels.title: Sold calls
panels.description: Individual sold calls for the selected time range and filters.

panels.title: Transfer calls
panels.description: Transfer call details for the selected dashboard time range and filters. Every column can be filtered directly from its header.

title: Convergence
description: Team-facing sales performance dashboard. Starts on today, puts Sold first, and keeps every view synchronized with the native Grafana filters.
